summary: Frontend-only iOS launch-freeze investigation completed: root/frontend Expo SDK57 configs are aligned, Expo doctor passes in both directories, scratch iOS prebuild shows required scene lifecycle entries, production iOS JS export succeeds (with --no-bytecode workaround in this Linux environment), and public preview core flow is navigable without launch freeze.

ui_bugs.issue: Most interactive controls are missing testID/data-testid attributes, forcing brittle text/coordinate selectors and lowering regression reliability.
ui_bugs.main_agent_verification: Added stable testIDs to welcome/profile/login screens in both projects. Screenshot tool reran welcome/language/English/sign-in/close/Explore/profile/language/sign-in using exact testIDs successfully. No auth behavior changes.

integration_issues.flow: Offline cold reload in web preview
integration_issues.issue: After toggling browser offline, full page reload fails with net::ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED (web runtime limitation). Session already loaded remained interactive and could navigate locally.

action_items: Upload and human-test signed TestFlight build 1.0.1(21) on iOS/iPadOS 27 devices; this environment cannot validate native runtime freeze behavior.
Add testID props to critical controls (welcome language globe, Explore CTA, sign-in links/buttons, profile auth CTAs) for stable Expo web/mobile automation.

If App Store freeze reproduces on build21, collect native launch/crash/hang logs for that exact binary to determine root cause; current checks confirm config compatibility gap was addressed but do not prove build18 causal RCA.
critical_code_review_comments: Confirmed config parity: /app and /app/frontend app/, src/, app.json, eas.json, package.json, yarn.lock are identical.
Confirmed versions in installed modules and manifests: expo 57.0.26 and expo-build-properties 57.0.22 in both roots.
Confirmed app.json plugin placement is correct: ios.enableSceneSupport=true under expo-build-properties (not in eas.json).

Scratch prebuild evidence matches Expo SDK57 scene lifecycle expectations: UIApplicationSceneManifest contains UISceneDelegateClassName=EXExpoAppSceneDelegate and AppDelegate conforms ExpoReactNativeFactoryProvider with modern startup path.
No React Native red screen encountered in preview flow tests.
remaining_verification: Exact signed TestFlight build1.0.1(21) on iOS/iPadOS27; no local/native runtime proof yet. Source/config and preview tests passed.
main_agent_environment_finding: Confirmed via troubleshoot: Linux host aarch64, shipped hermesc ELF x86-64; Exec format error is compiler-host architecture mismatch. --no-bytecode verifies JS output only, not native/Hermes build.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Initial export with Hermes bytecode failed in this container due hermesc binary execution issue; rerun export with --no-bytecode succeeded and validated route/assets output. This is environment/tooling behavior, not proof of app runtime issue on iOS devices.
rca_of_issue: Apple-reviewed binary was 1.0(18), while current workspace is 1.0.1(21). Confirmed previously missing scene lifecycle compatibility setting is now present and generated native files include expected SDK57/Xcode27 scene entries. Therefore: confirmed compatibility gap fixed in source/config; unconfirmed whether that alone caused build18 freeze due missing native logs and inability to run signed iOS27 runtime in this environment.
